name: Boom AI
long_description:
Boom reaches out to your customers before you lose them.

We run proactive outbound conversations at scale: recovering churned users, re-engaging drop-offs, and protecting revenue you thought was gone. AI agents hold real conversations with your customers over SMS, email, WhatsApp, or phone, in their language, on the channel they actually answer.

Every month, companies lose 5-15% of revenue to churn, and more walks out through abandoned signups and failed onboarding. The tools built to fix this don't work. Win-back emails get ignored. Cancel flows only catch people at the door. Hiring humans doesn't scale. Boom does the one thing that works: a real conversation. 1,000x the reach of manual outreach, and the customer can reply.
one_liner: AI agents that recover lost revenue through real conversations.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I’m the Co-Founder and CEO of Boom, where we’re building the AI employee layer for e-commerce: virtual agents that help brands close more sales by automating customer interactions. Before this, I dropped out of college to build Atrato (YC W21), one of Latin America’s leading Buy Now Pay Later companies, which I scaled from 0 to ~$20M in annualized revenue before it was acquired. I started as CTO and became CEO, which made learn how to sell, lead, and scale.

launches.title: Boom AI: Your AI Growth Team for E-commerce Brands 🚀
launches.tagline: Turn lost interactions into sales with your 24/7 AI team.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** – Boom is your AI growth team for e-commerce that handles sales, support, and retention automatically. Most brands focus on bringing visitors to their site, only to lose 99% of them before checkout. Boom changes that. Our AI replies to customer questions instantly over Whatsapp, Instagram, Facebook, and Web Chat. We also proactively reach out to customers by reminding them about abandoned carts and making personalized product recommendations. We've already become a top-five sales channel for our first customers.

https://youtu.be/IwUjEDUdUVY

Most e-commerce brands don’t lose customers because of bad products. They lose them because no one replies fast enough. 56% of all customer interactions happen outside working hours, and most go unanswered.

Boom gives every brand its own AI sales, support, and marketing team that works 24/7. It answers product and order questions, follows up on abandoned checkouts, notifies customers when items are back in stock, and runs personalized campaigns that bring them back to buy again. There’s no setup required. Just install Boom, and we’ll handle everything. Then sit back and watch as your AI team starts working for you.

In a short time, Boom has already become a top-five sales channel for our first customers. By personalizing every conversation, it turns missed messages into sales and long-term customer relationships.

E-commerce is a **six-trillion-dollar industry** where most stores still lose 99% of visitors. Boom helps brands change that by making every interaction personal, instant, and effective.

If you’d like to see Boom in action, email me at [**juan@useboom.ai**](mailto:juan@useboom.ai) or book a demo at [https://**useboom.ai**](https://useboom.ai).
